content.rendered:
Kinder Registration for Fall, 2022, is now open online and paper packets are available in the Archer Glen front office. More information can be viewed by clicking on the links below.

Kinder Open House is Thursday, March 3rd from 3:30 pm to 6:00 pm in the Archer Glen Gym. Families can enter under the covered play area off the parking lot. 20 minute time slots are available by signing up using the link below.

  • Welcome K Newsletter
  • Sign up for K Open House
